notes: v1: 9,652 tris, rigged with idle/walk/run. Reads as a German rifleman. Defects below.

defects.text: Helmet front edge sits at the eyebrows and hides the eyes.
defects.fix: Raise front edge to ~1.74 m and move shell back.

defects.text: Face relief is weak (nose, brow, lips barely read) and the jaw is pointy.
defects.fix: Stronger nose, brow, cheek, lip and chin displacement; less jaw taper.

defects.text: Boot top is jagged where the boot shaft intersects the trouser hem; toes are square slippers.
defects.fix: Smaller boot shaft, bloused trouser overhang, rounded toe cap.

defects.text: Sleeves start as open flared tubes that poke above the shoulder line, giving pointed shoulders.
defects.fix: Widen the tunic shoulder, start sleeves inside and cap them.

defects.text: Y-straps form horns above the shoulder; helmet rivets are lumps.
